title.en: Employees - adding and how they are paid

intro.sr: Administrator pravi zaposlenog od postojećeg korisnika: usluge, provizija i mesto za SrediMe kalendar.
intro.en: An administrator makes an employee from an existing user: services, commission and the place for the SrediMe calendar.

admin-zaposleni-klik-na-dodaj.sr: {Kliknemo} „Novi zaposleni“. Zaposleni se pravi od postojećeg korisničkog naloga, a ne od nule.
admin-zaposleni-klik-na-dodaj.en: We {click} “Novi zaposleni”. An employee is made from an existing user account, not from scratch.

zaposleni-korisnik.en: We choose the user who becomes an employee.

zaposleni-usluge.sr: Biramo usluge koje zaposleni izvodi. Samo za te usluge će mu sistem ponuditi termine.
zaposleni-usluge.en: We pick the services the employee performs. The system offers them appointments only for those.

zaposleni-isplata.sr: Fiksna plata ili provizija. Za proviziju upisujemo procenat, ovde 25%.
zaposleni-isplata.en: A fixed salary or commission. For commission we enter the percentage, here 25%.

zaposleni-sredime.sr: Ovde se upisuje SrediMe ICS adresa zaposlenog. Sistem je povremeno čita i blokira vreme koje je tamo već rezervisano, pa se isti termin ne prodaje dvaput.
zaposleni-sredime.en: This is where the employee's SrediMe ICS address goes. The system reads it periodically and blocks the time already booked there, so the same slot is never sold twice.

zaposleni-cuvanje.sr: Čuvamo zaposlenog. Radno vreme on sam podešava na svom nalogu.
zaposleni-cuvanje.en: We save the employee. They set their working hours themselves in their account.
